import sys

def main():
    input_lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    index = 0
    while index < len(input_lines):
        line = input_lines[index].split()
        index += 1
        if not line:
            continue
        n = int(line[0])
        s = line[1]
        ok = False
        one = 0
        tt = ""
        twoans = ""
        wordnok = True
        for c in range(n):
            ch = s[c]
            if ch == '(':
                ok = True
                wordnok = True
                tt = ""
            elif ch == ')':
                tt = ""
                ok = False
            else:
                if not ok:
                    if ch == '_':
                        tt = ""
                    else:
                        tt += ch
                    if len(tt) > len(twoans):
                        twoans = tt
                else:
                    if ch == '_':
                        wordnok = True
                    else:
                        if wordnok:
                            one += 1
                            wordnok = False
        print(f"{len(twoans)} {one}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
